// https://codeforces.com/contest/1278/submission/67223059 (rainboy)
import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class CF1278F extends PrintWriter {
	CF1278F() { super(System.out, true); }
	Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
	public static void main(String[] $) {
		CF1278F o = new CF1278F(); o.main(); o.flush();
	}

	static final int MD = 998244353;
	int d_, x_, y_;
	void gcd_(int a, int b) {
		if (b == 0) {
			d_ = a; x_ = 1; y_ = 0;
		} else {
			gcd_(b, a % b);
			int t = x_ - a / b * y_; x_ = y_; y_ = t;
		}
	}
	int inv(int a) {
		gcd_(a, MD);
		return x_ < 0 ? x_ + MD : x_;
	}
	void main() {
		int n = sc.nextInt();
		int m = sc.nextInt(), m_ = inv(m);
		int k = sc.nextInt();
		int[] dp = new int[k + 1]; dp[0] = 1;
		for (int h = 0; h < k; h++)
			for (int d = k - 1; d >= 0; d--)
				if (dp[d] != 0) {
					dp[d + 1] = (int) ((dp[d + 1] + (long) dp[d] * (n - d)) % MD);
					dp[d] = (int) ((long) dp[d] * d % MD);
				}
		long p = 1, ans = 0;
		for (int d = 1; d <= k; d++) {
			p = p * m_ % MD;
			ans = (ans + dp[d] * p) % MD;
		}
		println(ans);
	}
}
